condition: The glass bottle is empty, intact with no chips or cracks, and has its paper label attached.

safety.handling_warning: Handle with care to avoid dropping and shattering the glass.

concepts.title: Clean and Refill Storage
concepts.description: Restore the bottle to a clean, usable storage container for non-potable liquids or oils.
steps: Rinse the soda-lime glass bottle thoroughly with warm water to remove any residual beverage.
Apply a few drops of dish soap inside the bottle.
Insert a bottle brush and scrub the interior walls and bottom.
Rinse multiple times with clean water until all soap bubbles are gone.
Allow the bottle to air dry completely upside down.
concepts.image_prompt: A clean transparent soda-lime glass bottle on a neutral grey background with soft natural lighting.

concepts.title: Bud Vase
concepts.description: Transform the glass bottle into a minimalist single-stem flower vase.
steps: Wash the soda-lime glass bottle thoroughly and remove any excess moisture.
Soak the exterior paper label in warm soapy water for five minutes.
Peel off the paper label and scrub away any residual glue with a sponge.
Fill the bottle halfway with clean water.
Place a single fresh flower stem into the narrow neck of the bottle.
concepts.image_prompt: A clear glass bottle used as a vase holding a single flower stem, set against a plain soft background.

concepts.title: Sand-Etched Decorative Bottle
concepts.description: Create an artistic home decor piece by etching patterns onto the exterior glass surface.
steps: Clean and dry the soda-lime glass bottle completely.
Apply strips of masking tape around the bottle body to form geometric patterns.
Use a craft knife to carefully cut out designs from the tape.
Put on protective gloves and brush glass etching cream thickly over the exposed glass areas.
Leave the cream on for the duration specified by the manufacturer, usually about 15 minutes.
Rinse the cream off thoroughly under running water, then peel off the masking tape and wipe the glass clean.
concepts.image_prompt: An artfully etched clear glass bottle with frosted geometric patterns on a neutral surface, soft natural lighting.

recovery_plan.destination: kabadiwala (local scrap dealer) or municipal dry-waste collection
